notes.zh: 新增导入海外银行、信用卡账单（CSV 按列映射、OFX / QFX），按商户记住分类，自动跳过信用卡还款；英文界面新建家庭时默认分类和账户为英文。需要 Coinroof App 1.0.17 及以上。
notes.en: Import bank and credit card statements (CSV with column matching, OFX / QFX), with categories remembered per merchant and credit card payments skipped automatically. New families set up in English get English default categories and accounts. Requires Coinroof app 1.0.17 or later.
